_note: Prompts for AI-generated mood images (scripts/generate-images.mjs). Each product's subject comes only from the odour notes in its own description in products.json. These are illustrative mood images, not photographs of Petorose products or facilities; never generate the plant, lab or people.
style: Premium editorial macro still-life for a specialty aroma ingredients manufacturer. Include one unlabelled clear or amber borosilicate laboratory vial and a precise glass oil droplet. Soft directional window light, deep aubergine backdrop, restrained orchid and periwinkle rim light, shallow depth of field, natural materials, crisp botanical detail, generous negative space, minimal composition. Photorealistic mood image, not a literal photograph of the chemical or its source. No text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, no certification marks, no packaging, no people, no hands, no factory or laboratory interior.
